Aditya Roy Kapur Finds Love In Goan Model Georgina After Ananya Panday? 'Soft Launch' Pics Go Viral
The mystery woman in Aditya Roy Kapur's new post has caught everyone's attention. Some fans noted that his new girlfriend is Georgina Dsilva, a model from Goa.
Has Aditya Roy Kapur found love again after his breakup with Ananya Panday? This question has been on everyone’s mind since the actor shared his latest Instagram post, featuring a woman’s hand with white nail polish. Eagle-eyed fans were quick to notice that the hand in the photo looked like it belonged to Goan model Georgina Dsilva.
Aditya Roy Kapur took to Instagram on Wednesday to share photos from his latest getaway. He wrote, “A cosmic bonanza. Thanks @airbnb, good scene. I want the sink." Besides pictures of the house, his post included a video of him playing football with two women and a picture of a woman’s hand holding a snack. Check out the post here:

View this post on Instagram
Many understood Aditya’s post as a “soft launch" for his new girlfriend, and asked about the mystery girl’s identity. One person wrote, “Who’s he soft launching?" Another mentioned, “Has anyone noticed the hand?🤔🙆🏻♀️" One fan wrote, “Who’s the girl with white nail polish?" Another asked, “I wonder who that mystery girl is?"
Some fans noted that the mystery girl is Georgina Dsilva, a model from Goa. One person wrote, “She is @georginadsilva." Another mentioned, “Guys, the girl that he soft-launched is @georginadsilva!" While some argued that it was Sara Ali Khan’s hand in the picture as they are promoting their film, Metro In Dino, others maintained that it was Georgina’s hand.
View this post on Instagram
While Aditya Roy Kapur didn’t spill the beans about who he “soft-launched", fans noticed that Georgina sported similar nails in her latest post. They also noted that the actor and the model follow one another and often like each other’s Instagram posts. Meanwhile, some fans couldn’t help gush over the idea that Aditya Roy Kapur might have found love again.
The actor was previously dating Ananya Panday. Ananya and Aditya reportedly dated for nearly two years before calling it quits. Ananya Panday and Aditya Roy Kapur’s breakup rumours made headlines in April last year after the actress shared a cryptic note on her Instagram stories.
Later, a close friend of the two actors confirmed their breakup and told the Bombay Times, “Ananya is trying to move on; of course, there’s hurt. Aditya is also trying to deal with the situation maturely." However, it should also be noted that Ananya and Aditya have not reacted to their breakup rumours. They also never explicitly spoke about their relationship. After their breakup, Ananya is rumoured to be dating Walker Blanco.
